_comment: USD per million tokens. Each model carries input/output and, where the provider publishes one, a per-model `cached` price for cache-read input tokens. When a model has no `cached` key the fallback is cache_read_multiplier x its input price. Unknown models are warned about and priced at 0. Confirm on the provider's live pricing page before spending (plan section 8).
_source: provider pricing pages and the OpenRouter models API, fetched 2026-09-15; see `sources`. Supersedes the orchestrator-supplied table of 2026-09-13, kept verbatim at analysis/prices-2026-09-13.json because results/analysis/spend.md was generated against it.
